calculatorLockVault.calculatorvault_stor: The artifact reports the files under the .Calculator_Lock folder on each Android user's external storage, which this fixture holds at data/media/0. The second-tenant leg copies only the data/data members under data/user/10, not the data/media/0 files, so user 10 holds a database and no stored files and the count stays at 1 against the expected 2. On a constructed two-user tree holding user 10's database and a data/media/10 copy of the photo, the artifact reports 2 rows, one for each user, each named in its own user's Hide table (checked 2026-09-28).
smsmms.get_sms_mms_attachments.anne_a15[: The artifact adds one row per attachment file no part row references. The second-tenant leg duplicates the database under data/user/10 but not the user_de attachment folder its part rows point at, so the copied rows resolve to user 0's files and the one unreferenced file is reported once, not twice: 21 rows against the expected 22. A real second user's database records data/user_de/10 paths, which the recorded-path join follows (checked 2026-09-02 on a constructed two-user tree, 18 distinct media items from two users).
yandexDisk.yandex_disk_image_cache.cases: The artifact reports one row per file in the app's image cache, which each Android user keeps in its own external storage and this fixture holds at data/media/0. The second-tenant leg copies only the data/data members to data/user/10, so the cache files are not duplicated and the count cannot double. The full synthetic tree, which carries a cache at data/media/10, gives that user its own row.
The artifact keys a session on the Android user and the History folder name. The fixture already holds a second user (data/user/10) with the folder that user 0 also has, so the second-tenant leg, which restages user 0's data/data members under data/user/10, lands on that existing folder and adds only the one folder the fixture's user 10 lacks: 3 rows become 4, not the 6 a doubling would give. The other seven Smart Switch artifacts double as expected on the same leg. The same artifact reports 3 rows on the fixture itself, one per (user, folder) pair, which the unit tests check.
